exposure: Induction of labor with vaginal prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) gel
sequential double-balloon catheter and vaginal prostaglandin E2
Induction of labor with double-balloon catheter followed by vaginal PGE2
cohort: 264 pregnant women with previous cesarean section undergoing labor induction at term
finding: The sequential application of double-balloon catheter and vaginal PGE2 is as effective as the sole use of vaginal PGE2 for labor induction, but requires fewer PGE2 applications and a lower total amount of PGE2.
mod_finding: The study compared cesarean section rates between labor induction using a double-balloon catheter followed by vaginal PGE2 versus vaginal PGE2 alone.
